import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*L+p[2]*eps+p[3]*eps**2+p[4]/eps
            +T*(p[5]+p[6]*L+p[7]*eps)+T**2*(p[8]+p[9]*L))
